alexander-the-greats-reign: In 13 years Alexander builds an empire from Greece to Egypt and the edge of India.
taiping-rebellion: A civil war against the Qing that kills an estimated 20–30 million people.
congo-free-state: King Leopold II rules the Congo as his private property; forced labour for rubber kills millions.
einsteins-annus-mirabilis: Four papers in one year — the photoelectric effect, Brownian motion, special relativity and E = mc² — written while working as a patent clerk in Bern.
benazir-bhutto-becomes-prime-minister: The first woman elected to lead a Muslim-majority country.
